scope: Current C17 ancestry, Atlas recall scope and historical calculation authority integration. Reconciles the earlier COMPOSE4 external findings; not a review of every COMPOSE5 domain or BI lifecycle source.

findings.title: Historical C17 continuation is not wired through the current host and BCS gates
trace: A persisted canonical scenario request/result belongs to case incarnation I at producer version v. Its exact C17 reference is accepted into a persisted event and the same case advances to v+1.
COMPOSE5 issue and resolveEvidence invoke only ordinary requests.read/readForCalculation; those current-only reads reject the producer version once the case advances.

Atlas recordOnlyRequest requires both persisted request.caseRef and result.caseRef to equal the selected current caseRef. The v/v+1 reference is therefore ineligible for proof reuse; recall preserves the original path rather than invoking the explicit historical APIs.

Even if the host were later to return a historical calculation, BCS requires sameHistoricalSource and continuity. sameHistoricalSource has record/document/receipt/case-event branches but no calculation branch, so a historical C17 result is unavailable.
findings.impact: Authorized historical calculation evidence can become unavailable after accepting the analysis or another legitimate case version increment. This is a continuity/availability failure, not evidence of unauthorized access.
findings.fixBoundary: An explicit historical host lane must select a real persisted ledger member under current authorization, retain exact original request/result/reference, same case incarnation and allowed horizon, replay sources, and use readHistoricalCalculation/readHistorical. The BCS calculation continuity branch must be separately defined and proven. Do not relax ordinary reads or return fabricated fresh evidence. Host/BCS edits remain external-owner proposals.
findings.validationNeeded: Exact composed Actions test: persist real calculation, accept it into a real ledger event, advance the case and successfully resolve/recall through the historical lane. Negative cases for nonmembership, altered reference/result/request, different incarnation/horizon, revoked access, changed source and absent/revoked continuity. Public ordinary reads must still reject stale producer versions.
findings.proof: Static call trace over exact pinned sources; no composed execution by reviewer.

findings.title: The prior binding-global replay Map claim no longer applies
findings.observation: The wrapper uses AsyncLocalStorage. It inherits ancestors only for an open scope with the same context object, Request identity and binding digest; every nested call creates a new set. Repeated ancestors and path depth >=16 still fail closed. Finally closes the scope. Independent roots do not share a binding-global active map.
findings.limits: This is source verification of the external wrapper fix, not an executed concurrency receipt for COMPOSE5. The Atlas helper has separate scoped proof-reuse guards; their presence must not be mislabeled as the old replay Map defect.

reconciledFacts: Nested C17 producer composition exists; the older record-only-only claim is not current.
Planner record historical continuity is present and distinct from historical calculation continuation.

Atlas proof reuse is limited to one authenticated recall, record-only calculations eligible at the exact selected version, complete state/source/day fences and final egress checks. It does not itself introduce the historical calculation APIs.
The approved own historical APIs remain an explicit separate lane, and their existence alone is not a complete host/BCS integration.

proof.method: Static source inspection and exact Git blob/SHA256 verification

limitations: Only the four listed authority sources and related intake descriptions were reviewed for this reconciliation; other COMPOSE5 BI/portfolio changes are outside scope.
No current COMPOSE5 executed CI receipt is claimed here.
Financial result completeness, accepted ChoiceRecord, applied effect and authoritative receipt remain separate proof boundaries.
